cases.title: Skip ready candidates before expensive lowering
cases.scope: Current ordinary prepared QBE route, rather than obsolete p126bp_close replay.
cases.whatWorkDisappears: No newly demonstrated work: p128raw_plan_finish already retains raw candidates; p128raw_close reuses them and p113d_pass_function already drops ready names.
cases.limits: A stronger private-first/generic-elision proposal needs independent public ABI, continuation, closure, descriptor, constructor/static and ordered-ID reachability evidence. A ready private name alone cannot justify omitting generic lowering.

cases.title: Share one flat-binding use summary across keep/live consumers
cases.scope: The exact p111_keep plus nc_live_env expression pair in p113pl_bind_flat, with complete keep arguments and all retained binding fields consumed. Fixture construction and output observation are included.
cases.whatWorkDisappears: One repeated nc_uses(body) traversal and NU_Set construction/destruction; nc_live_uses reuses the first immutable summary.
cases.limits: Synthetic compiler-shaped terms, actual maintained analysis functions. Not complete product lowering. Substitution, reanalysis of transformed bodies, p113p_bindable, ownership policy and independent verifier remain untouched. Existing boxed/liveness/constructor sharing is not counted anew. Empty environments and early failures can reduce profitability.

cases.title: Fuse inline cleanliness, node-count and stack summaries
cases.scope: Complete three-field semantic summary over actual P113DStmt/N111Stmt grammar; every field observed as clean:size:stack. Original leaf policies and saturating additions retained.
cases.whatWorkDisappears: Repeated body/branch traversal for size and stack; leaf rules are reused and the candidate pays temporary P155BStats records.
cases.limits: Analysis kernel only, not full optimizer. p113i_function checks the original body while p113i_table_function may inspect a rewritten body: facts must be recomputed at that boundary. The benchmark cannot justify reusing pre-rewrite facts or removing any eligibility/admission/verifier gate. Clean-failure short circuit may favor original; summary allocation may erase traversal savings.
cases.independentExpected: For generated n-block bodies: clean:min(4096,7*n+1):min(65536,96*n), within tested n range. n=1 is clean:8:96.
